title: Project created on Windows 4.2 won’t open in Godot 4.2–4.5.1 on Linux (editor fails, game runs)
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.2 stable
- 4.3 stable
- 4.5.1 stable

### System information

Garuda Linux (Arch-based), kernel LTS, NVIDIA Quadro K1100M(NVIDIA 390.157 (Vulkan 1.0.65))

### Issue description

I have a project that was created on Windows using Godot 4.2. On Linux (Garuda Linux, LTS kernel) with an NVIDIA Quadro K1100M (driver 390.157), the editor does not open, but the game itself runs if executed.

Godot versions tested: 4.2 stable, 4.3 stable, 4.5.1 stable

OS: Garuda Linux (Arch-based), kernel LTS

GPU: NVIDIA Quadro K1100M

Drivers: NVIDIA 390.157 (Vulkan 1.0.65)

Problem description: When opening the project in the editor, no window appears. Running the project works fine. Other projects open correctly in the editor.

Removing the import/ folder and clearing editor cache did not help; the editor still fails to open this project

Open it in Godot 4.2–4.5.1 editor.

Editor window does not appear; game runs if executed.
